scope: ngspice model of the VCF built from the KiCad netlist, compared with published analysis and published claims about the TB-303. Nothing is measured on hardware.

checks.check: vcf-parts.json matches the current KiCad schematic
Every reference on the expanded BOM's VCF list is in the deck
Ladder denominator with equal caps is x^4+7x^3+15x^2+10x+1
Ladder denominator with the bottom cap halved is 0.5x^4+4x^3+10x^2+8x+1
Feedback gain needed to oscillate with equal caps is about 18.4
SPICE ladder is within 0.1 dB of the analytic response at 1 kHz
SPICE and analytic -3 dB corners coincide
Roll-off steepens to 24 dB/oct, passing 18 dB/oct on the way
1N4148s at the ladder top add gain, and forcing N to 1 removes it
TM3 can reach the kit tuning band, 400 to 600 Hz
TM3 reaches 500 Hz in every tolerance sample
Simulated square is near the kit figures of about 4 Vpp on 7 V
With both knobs down the note is almost sinusoidal
Stock filter does not sustain oscillation at any cutoff tested
With feedback doubled it sustains at mid and high cutoff and not at the lowest
Heavy input quenches the resonance and leaves the fundamental
Accent is a direct pulse with Resonance low and a lag with it high
Repeated accents stack at full Resonance
Env Mod cannot reach zero: at 0 % the note still sweeps
More Env Mod lowers the resting cutoff
Bass is down by the same order as the manual, and C20/C21 cause it
Resonance Q rises with cutoff
Margin is below 0 dB as built, and flat just above 0 dB with the two losses removed
Q rises with Q21's hFE at every cutoff
Q12 hFE across the datasheet range barely changes the loop margin
Q22 hFE across the datasheet range barely changes the loop margin
Envelope leakage grows with Q12 offset, and stays well below the notes up to 3 mV
Q22, Q21 and ladder offsets of 10 mV leave the envelope leakage unchanged
Q22 needs no matching: no difference between its halves moves the margin
A difference in hFE between Q12's halves does not move the margin
Q12 tolerates a 10 mV Vbe offset, and 30 mV costs real Q
Q21's hFE match matters: hFE 800 and 250 cut its Q at the top of the range by more than half
Across the tolerance run, self-oscillation appears only at the top of the range
No machine-specific paths in the study
Four demonstration WAVs, mono 48 kHz, 4.35 s

open_items: The taper of VR3 is unknown; only the knob-to-Hz map depends on it.
The sub-audio loop crossing near 6 to 8 Hz is a model-only prediction, unconfirmed by any report found.
The transistor models are substitutes; IS, VAF and the capacitance split are generic values.
The VCO is an ideal saw, and the VCA and output stage are not simulated.
